name: HDFC Asset Management Company Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1999, HDFC Asset Management Company Ltd provides Fund Management Services[1]
keyPoints:
Promoter
As of Sep 2025, HDFC Bank holds a 52.42% stake in the company. HDFC Bank is India’s largest private sector bank by assets, with a presence across transaction banking, retail, MSME, and corporate banking. It has 9,455 branches, 21,139 ATMs spread cross 4,150 cities/towns and a presence in key global markets.  [1] [2]

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 29.1%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 75.6%
cons: Stock is trading at 14.7 times its book value
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -10.4%
